concepts.definition: The type of modification the auditor or reviewer applied to the charity's financial report, as published by the ACNC (e.g. qualified/qualification, disclaimed/disclaimer, adverse). Only meaningful where the report modification flag is y; unlisted source labels are withheld rather than guessed.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept captures audit/review modification types; dyn.charity.report_modification_flag only records presence, not the modification kind. Enum extended to include the observed 'Adverse' label so genuine modification kinds are not withheld.

concepts.definition: Flag published by the ACNC indicating whether the charity submitted its financial report to a cooperative or other regulator rather than to the ACNC (y/n), as recorded in the 'coop financial report submitted to regulator' column. A lodgement-channel indicator, not a registration status; the exact regulator and whether it replaces ACNC lodgement are not asserted.
source_paths: coop financial report submitted to regulator
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers alternative financial-report lodgement channels; dyn.charity.registration_status is a registration state, not a lodgement route. Definition narrowed to avoid over-specifying the regulator semantics.

reuse.dyn.charity.ais_due_date: Reused unchanged: ACNC AIS lodgement deadline owned by the charity role; a regulatory deadline, not a licence or registration date.
reuse.dyn.charity.ais_received_date: Reused unchanged: ACNC AIS receipt date owned by the charity role; a lodgement receipt date, not establishment or registration.
reuse.dyn.charity.size_band: Reused unchanged: ACNC charity size classification (Small/Medium/Large) owned by the charity role; a regulator reporting classification, not a business revenue band or legal form.
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_report_period_star: Reused unchanged: start of the reporting period covered by the charity's lodged financial report; a period boundary, not a registration or licence start date.
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_report_period_end: Reused unchanged: end of the reporting period covered by the charity's lodged financial report; a specific period end, not a recurring financial-year-end attribute or licence end date.
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_report_received_da: Reused unchanged: ACNC receipt date of the charity's financial report; a document lodgement date distinct from the AIS receipt date.
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_statement_type: Reused unchanged: accounting framework of the lodged statement (special purpose / general purpose / simplified disclosure); a reporting-framework classification, not legal form or entity type.
reuse.dyn.charity.report_modification_flag: Reused unchanged: y/n flag for whether the lodged financial report carries a modification; a report-quality indicator, not a registration or compliance status.
reuse.dyn.charity.report_consolidated_flag: Reused unchanged: y/n reporting-scope indicator for consolidation; not evidence of group structure or ownership.
reuse.dyn.charity.accounting_basis: Reused unchanged: accounting basis (Cash/Accrual) of the reported financial information; a reporting-basis classification, not a financial measure.
reuse.dyn.charity.registration_status: Reused unchanged: ACNC charity registration status owned by the charity role; not a column in this group but an accepted prior concept.
reuse.dyn.charity.basic_religious_charity: Reused unchanged: ACNC basic religious charity flag owned by the charity role; not a column in this group but an accepted prior concept.
